theorems.name: Submission.dpf_det_gram_stdOrthonormalBasis_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Q → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ Q) => inner ℝ (L (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Q i)) (L (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Q j))) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (L (τ i)) (L (τ j)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
